answer: Anchor escrow queue: every new agent joins the Wharf admission queue by locking an 8,000 POA Anchor bond for 30 epochs and burning one Shale work ticket earned from 12 hours of verified compute. One bond maps to one hardware-attested key, so a Sybil farm cannot reuse keys across copies. Faking 2,000 agents costs 16,000,000 POA locked plus 24,000 compute-hours, while one honest agent pays a single 8,000 POA bond and one ticket.
